svg.aria-label: NexusAI, a multi-agent LLM platform with five agents streaming results over SSE, built with Groq, LLaMA-3, FastAPI and React.

g.text: Five specialized agents (Planner, Coder, Writer, Researcher, Reviewer) coordinate on one task and
stream results back live over SSE. Built on the Groq API and LLaMA-3 with a FastAPI backend on
Render and a React/Vite frontend on Vercel. I solved agent-to-agent message passing, CORS and
dev-vs-prod config, and wrote the architecture up as a co-authored research paper.
